story.originalTitle: Behind what happens on track is how quickly a team can turn information into a decision. Together with @zscaler, we explore how to pick up pace while ...
story.summaryEn:
Behind what happens on track is how quickly a team can turn information into a decision.
Together with @zscaler, we explore how to pick up pace while protecting the data behind every move.
This is what #SecuringSpeed means.
detailZh:
赛道背后，是车队将信息转化为决策的速度。
与@zscaler一起，我们探讨如何在保护每一步背后的数据的同时提高速度。
这就是#SecuringSpeed的含义。
detailEn:
Behind what happens on track is how quickly a team can turn information into a decision.
Together with @zscaler, we explore how to pick up pace while protecting the data behind every move.
This is what #SecuringSpeed means.
